name: KubeCompass desktop Kubernetes workspace
description: Platform-neutral contract for the K-Dex-derived desktop workspace; topology uses Outline by default, a selected-root bounded Map, typed Paths, and a persistent evidence inspector. webapp is the schema's nearest application-platform value.
